statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-42009 (GNUTLS-SA-2026-04-29-2): the comparator used to order DTLS handshake packets by sequence number (lib/buffers.c) broke the qsort comparator contract when two packets had the same sequence number, which could lead to undefined behaviour. Upstream says modern glibc systems, which do not fall back to a quicksort implementation, are not affected; the DHI Alpine builds of libgnutls.so.30 link musl's C library (libc.musl-x86_64.so.1 or libc.musl-aarch64.so.1), so the status follows the version. GnuTLS fixed it in 3.8.13 with commits f341441fad91142897d83b44a175ffc8f925b76f and f01e21441e29052a6f0963840794c41d3b3ee66d: https://gitlab.com/gnutls/gnutls/-/commit/f341441fad91142897d83b44a175ffc8f925b76f, https://gitlab.com/gnutls/gnutls/-/commit/f01e21441e29052a6f0963840794c41d3b3ee66d, https://gnutls.org/security-new.html, https://gitlab.com/gnutls/gnutls/-/blob/3.8.14/NEWS . Alpine's 3.23-stable gnutls APKBUILD builds gnutls from the upstream release and lists CVE-2026-42009 under its 3.8.13-r0 security fixes: https://gitlab.alpinelinux.org/alpine/aports/-/blob/3.23-stable/main/gnutls/APKBUILD . We downloaded every package built from the gnutls source in the Alpine 3.23 index of the DHI Alpine repository: gnutls, gnutls-c++, gnutls-dbg, gnutls-dev, gnutls-doc and gnutls-utils, each at 3.8.11-r0, 3.8.12-r0, 3.8.13-r0 and 3.8.14-r0 for x86_64 and aarch64, 48 apks, and checked each download against its index checksum; no gnutls package is published in the DHI Alpine security repository. The library code is in libgnutls.so.30 in the gnutls package; gnutls-c++ ships the C++ wrapper libgnutlsxx.so.30, the seven gnutls-utils programs list libgnutls.so.30 as a needed library, gnutls-dev ships headers, pkg-config data and the libgnutls.so and libgnutlsxx.so symbolic links and no static library, and gnutls-dbg ships debug symbols. The GnuTLS version string in libgnutls.so.30 reads 3.8.11, 3.8.12, 3.8.13 and 3.8.14 in the matching builds on both architectures. So 3.8.11-r0 and 3.8.12-r0 are affected and 3.8.13-r0 is the first fixed build; 3.8.14-r0 also carries the fix.
